claim_ceiling: bounded route recommendation / route block / surface-admissibility decision only

routes.name: ACTION-CONDITIONED-PREDICTIVE-BOUNDARY-VIABILITY
strongest_baselines: simple causal transition learner without boundary state
routes.strongest_objection: ACP-BV may collapse into ordinary model-based control or reward shaping; if viability is just reward or boundary memory is a hidden lookup table, downgrade or block.
routes.downgrade_rule: If boundary-memory mutation, persistence-disabled intervention, or capacity-disabled intervention does not change pre-registered behavior, downgrade to world-model-only or block.
routes.recommendation_rationale: This route directly targets the failure family preserved by the ACSB downgrade while allowing hard gates against oracle, lookup, fake learner, inert boundary, and replay-tautology collapse.

routes.name: world-model-only causal intervention surface
routes.strongest_objection: This route can test action-conditioned prediction/adaptation but cannot by itself support a boundary or viability proxy claim.
routes.fallback_condition: Use Route B if ACP-BV cannot specify or later satisfy boundary-memory causal-dependence and non-oracle gates.
routes.recommendation_rationale: It is lower-risk and useful as a substrate, but selecting it as primary would be a route downgrade rather than a boundary-proxy advance.

routes.name: social / ACSB re-entry family
routes.strongest_objection: Immediate ACSB/social re-entry repeats the sealed current-route failure pattern and is not authorized by this boundary.
routes.future_reentry_condition: A separate route-decision card would be required for a materially different surface.
routes.recommendation_rationale: The current ACSB route is downgraded and sealed; fe5aa85 is invalid-harness blocker evidence only, not accepted ACSB negative evidence.

unknowns.item: Whether a future ACP-BV executable surface can actually satisfy the non-oracle, fair-baseline, boundary-causal, and replay-recomputation gates.
unknowns.routing_effect: Unknown does not authorize implementation; it defines the next task-card drafting burden.

assumptions.item: Future task-card drafting can specify admissibility gates without creating candidate code.
assumptions.routing_effect: If this assumption fails, route selection should freeze or downgrade to world-model-only.
